evidence.excerpt: As of December 31, 2025, our installed base was over 3,000 systems.

notes: Camtek's own stated cumulative installed base across all currently sold tool platforms (Eagle, Hawk, MicroProf families), as of 2025-12-31. 'Over 3,000' -> relation gt (per the atlas vocabulary, 'over'/'more than'/'above' are gt, distinct from a '+' suffix which would be ge). Filed at multi_equipment (not all_businesses) because this is an equipment count basket spanning inspection and metrology tool types, not a company financial total; see camtek_installed_base scope definition.

evidence.excerpt: As of December 31, 2023, our installed base was over 2,150 systems.

notes: Camtek's own stated cumulative installed base, as of 2023-12-31, from the earlier (FY2023) 20-F -- the FY2025 20-F does not repeat this 2023 figure (it only states 2025's), so this is the only source for the 2023 data point. 'Over 2,150' -> relation gt.

evidence.excerpt: Approximately 50% of our revenues are generated from products supporting the production of artificial intelligence (“AI”) applications, and significant portion of our growth expected in the coming few years is derived from such products. We have experienced increased demand for inspection and metrology systems as customers invest in equipment supporting the production of AI related products, including high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced packaging.

notes: THE HEADLINE FIGURE FOR THIS PACKET'S POINT 2 (Camtek). Camtek's own stated revenue exposure to AI-related products 'including high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced packaging' -- approximately 50% of total revenue. This is NOT an HBM-specific split: HBM is one of several named AI-related products within the 50%, alongside advanced packaging generally; Camtek gives no finer breakdown isolating HBM's own share. Stated in the Risk Factors section of the FY2025 20-F with no explicit calendar date attached to the sentence itself; date_basis inferred_from_reporting_period attributes it to the fiscal year the filing reports on (FY2025) rather than inventing a specific date. This sentence does not appear in the FY2023 20-F (full-text checked), so it is new to the FY2025 filing and should not be assumed to hold for earlier years.

evidence.original_label: sales to China being 49% of our total revenues
evidence.excerpt: In 2025, our sales in the Asia Pacific region (mainly China, Taiwan and South Korea) accounted for approximately 91% of our total revenues with sales to China being 49% of our total revenues.

notes: Camtek's own stated China revenue share, explicitly dated 'In 2025'. Filed at all_businesses/company (a geographic cut of total company revenue, not an equipment-category basket). Registered relation eq because 'sales to China being 49%' carries no 'approximately' qualifier of its own in the sentence (unlike the preceding Asia-Pacific-region figure, which IS qualified 'approximately 91%' and is NOT separately registered here to avoid a labelling trap: the filing's revenue-by-geography TABLE elsewhere uses 'Asia Pacific' as a narrower bucket that EXCLUDES China and Korea as separate line items -- i.e. this risk-factor paragraph's 'Asia Pacific region (mainly China, Taiwan and South Korea)' and the geography table's 'Asia Pacific' line are NOT the same denominator, and conflating them would be an error. geography_basis 'destination_of_shipment' taken from Camtek's own stated methodology elsewhere in this filing ('Revenues are attributable to geographic areas/countries based upon the destination of shipment of products and related services').
